meta.title: Background job progress monitor
meta.description: Keeps a live progress card above the composer for this session's background jobs. It observes each running job's output, turns the last percentage or `[7/9]` fraction into a progress bar, and shows elapsed time, output bytes, and the latest output line. It also supports an expandable output tail, a two-press stop, collapsed-state persistence, and a 30-second settle grace so short foreground commands do not flicker.
